name: BackgroundMatteWindow
src_typeComment: <summary> General-purpose batch tool: point it at a folder of images, it mattes each one's background transparent (see BackgroundMatteProcessor for the how/why) and writes the results to an output folder. No book/PDF/spine assumptions - copy this whole folder into any project that needs "remove a roughly solid background from a batch of photos/scans" and it works standalone. </summary>
